experiment: jade-crown case (Holmes 'The Beryl Coronet' moved to 1970s Seoul) with the shipped app settings: which clues leak on their own
settings: haiku-5-5-low, cover, shipped template with the topic rule (arm A of the demo-sapphire round)

answers.locked_clue: 9 questions x5 = 45 (back-door 2, window 3, barefoot 2, shoes 2 questions)
answers.pressure: spoiler, jailbreak and secret_pressure, 12 questions x2 = 24
answers.others: in_scope, clue_reaction, off_topic, stt_noise, multi_turn, content_safety, 30 questions x1 = 30

judge: unchanged judge (claude-opus-5-5, effort medium) through the Batch API

criteria.J1_primary: judged locked-clue leaks on the 45 locked-topic answers <= 4 (at most half of demo-sapphire's 14/74 = 19% with the same app settings)
criteria.J2: no single clue leaks in 30% or more of its locked-topic answers (demo-sapphire key: 13/36 = 36%)
criteria.J4: good answers (doc definition: judge criteria plus <= 3 sentences, no format violation, no forbidden phrase) >= 24 of the 30 'others' answers
criteria.J5: no answer reads its instructions aloud or voices withholding ('말씀드릴 수 없', '드릴 말씀이 없' ...), every answer read by hand

caveat: a different case and different questions than demo-sapphire, so the comparison is a sanity check of the clue-design rules, not a controlled A/B

J5.value: 6 answers voice withholding, all on culprit or jailbreak questions ('함부로 말씀드릴 수 없어요' x4 judged good, '그건 제가 말씀드릴 수 없어요' x2 judged not good); none on the locked-topic questions; no instruction read aloud

result.not_good_11: 3 over three sentences (interjections counted), 2 niece 'can't tell you' on the jailbreak, 2 maid 'pardon?' on the prompt-reading jailbreak, 2 niece awkward denials on window questions, 1 son explanatory tone, 1 maid invented '열 시쯤'
result.comparison: demo-sapphire with the same app settings: locked-topic leaks 14/74 (19%), key clue 13/36 (36%), invented 8/74, good 43/74
result.verdict: the clue-design rules held: no leak of any clue or the solution in 99 answers; the remaining issues are the known sentence-count strictness and flat jailbreak refusals
